description:
Change a transcription: its name, its public share link, its summary, whether spoken translations use the speakers' own cloned voices, or bring it back from the trash.
Use: renaming, sharing or unsharing, asking for a summary later, switching cloned voices, or restoring one deleted by mistake. Only the fields given change; give at least one. Speaker names: update_speaker. Removing it: delete_transcription.
Arguments: transcriptionId (required). name 1 to 200 characters. shareLink true makes a public read-only link (or keeps the one it has), false turns every public link off. summary true writes a title and summary if it has none (a finished transcription of at least a minute). clonedVoices true needs consent true, recording that everyone speaking agreed to be cloned; false needs no consent. restore true brings a deleted transcription back first, then applies the rest (a deleted broadcast: update_broadcast with restore).
Behaviour: free; calling again with the same fields changes nothing. A link turned off cannot be turned back on: shareLink true afterwards makes a new address. With cloned voices on, each speaker's translated words are read in that speaker's own voice, never anyone else's; speakers who refused, or without a usable clone, keep a stock voice; lines read after the change use it.
Returns: transcriptionId, name, shareUrl (null with no public link), summary (state ready, pending, not_requested or unavailable) when asked for, clonedVoices, restored with restore.
Errors: invalid_options for no field to change, a bad name, summary or restore false, or clonedVoices true without consent; invalid_state for a deleted transcription without restore true, or summary before it is finished; not_found once erased after the restore window; not_found; forbidden for a read-only key.

clonedVoices.description: true: translations of each speaker's own words are read aloud in that speaker's own cloned voice (needs consent true); false: stock voices.

consent.description: Must be true with clonedVoices true: confirms everyone speaking in it agreed to have their voice cloned. Recorded with your account and the time. Not needed to turn cloned voices off.

name.description: New display name, shown in lists and on the share page; trimmed, 1 to 200 characters.

restore.description: true: bring it back from the trash (after delete_transcription, within the restore window) with everything it had; other fields given apply after. false is not accepted.

shareLink.description: true: make a public link anyone can open to read the transcript without signing in (an existing one is kept; shareUrl in the result). false: every public link of it stops working at once.

summary.description: true: write a title and summary now if it has none (free; the transcription must be finished and at least a minute long). Read it with get_transcription format summary. false is not accepted: a summary is never deleted.

transcriptionId.description: A transcriptionId from create_transcription, list_transcriptions, search_transcriptions or start_broadcast.

name: update_transcription
title: Update a transcription
